==English==
[[Image:Perspectiva-2.jpg|thumb|right|Illustration of the use of perspective to create the perception of depth in a two-dimensional projection.]]

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*speḱ-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|perspective|perspective, perspectif}}, attested since 1381, from {{der|en|fro|-}} or {{der|en|frm|-}}, from the first word of the {{der|en|la-med|perspectiva|perspectiva ars|science of optics}}, the feminine of {{der|en|la|perspectivus||of sight, optical}}, from {{m|la|perspectus}}, the past participle of {{m|la|perspicere||to inspect, look through}}, itself from {{m|la|per-||through}} + {{m|la|specere||to look at}}; the noun sense was influenced or mediated by {{cog|it|prospettiva}}, from {{m|it|prospetto||prospect}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/pɚˈspɛk.tɪv/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-perspective.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# A [[view]], [[vista]] or [[outlook]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2025 February 5|author=Peter Plisner|title=East West Rail: progress from west to east|journal=RAIL|issue=1028|page=30|text=And according to Hughes, HM Treasury is still sceptical about rail electrification. "It's not because they don't see electrification as a good thing, but I think when you look at it from the UK-wide '''perspective''', if you have £x billion to spend on decarbonisation, you don't necessarily start with rail. Rail's not where you get the biggest bang for the buck in terms of decarbonisation."}}
# The [[appearance]] of [[depth]] in [[object]]s, especially as [[perceive]]d using [[binocular]] vision.
# The [[technique]] of [[representing]] [[three-dimensional]] objects on a [[two-dimensional]] [[surface]].
# {{lb|en|dated}} An [[artwork]] that represents three-dimensional objects in this way.
# {{lb|en|figuratively}} The choice of a single angle or [[point of view]] from which to [[sense]], [[categorize]], [[measure]] or [[codify]] [[experience]].
# The ability to consider things in such relative perspective.
# A [[perspective glass]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1645|author={{w|Joseph Hall (bishop)|Joseph Hall}}|title=The Peace-Maker
|passage={{...}} our predecessors; who could never have believed, that there were such lunets about some of the planets, as our late '''perspectives''' have descried {{...}}}}
# A [[sound]] [[recording]] technique to adjust and integrate sound sources seemingly naturally.
